source: Figma MCP get_metadata; representative live browser reference inspection

rows.mapping: Simple and grouped navigation use UiNavigationMenu; slim uses UiRail; dual tier uses leadingRail; mobile uses UiDrawer. Header, search, secondary groups, featured content and account/footer are slots. Selected, expanded, disabled and badges are controlled. Search story filters groups and children.
remainingGaps: Full combinatorial visual parity, manual assistive technology and physical device acceptance are not confirmed.

rows.mapping: 45 source Type values have individually named recipes composed from actual controls. Stacked, centered and horizontal header layouts; image, crop, forms, selection, carousel, upload, date, invitations, profile, payment and action arrangements are explicit. Vertical-fill, horizontal-fill, left-aligned and checkbox footer variants preserve anatomy. Host owns validation, permissions and persistence.
remainingGaps: Full combinatorial visual parity, manual assistive technology and physical device acceptance are not confirmed.

rows.mapping: Commands support labels, descriptions, grouped sections, keywords, leading glyphs or arbitrary avatar/integration content, shortcut hints, disabled reasons, custom header/filter/footer slots and empty state. Arrow traversal skips disabled rows; Enter selects and Escape closes. Shortcut hints do not register global shortcuts.
remainingGaps: Full combinatorial visual parity, manual assistive technology and physical device acceptance are not confirmed.

rows.mapping: All 16 source Type values have recipes. Filter groups/search/saved preset, labels, chat, upload, notification preferences, payment, order, plan and profile use controlled widgets. Start/end placement follows reading direction; short-height headers and footers have bounded scroll regions so keyboard insets cannot hide content.
remainingGaps: Full combinatorial visual parity, manual assistive technology and physical device acceptance are not confirmed.
